node_definition.done_when: An obligation follows the run's current head. In reckon/crew/obligations.py, from the moment a complete run is resumed until it delivers again, its review-missing and promotable-stale duties for the prior head are withdrawn; when the run delivers, the duties return naming the new head. A review queued for the prior head is withdrawn rather than launched when its reviewed run has been resumed since it was queued, recorded as superseded by that resume, through the reflex's dispatch in reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py and the resume path in reckon/crew/resumption.py. A run that is not resumed keeps its duties. New tests in tests/test_a_duty_follows_the_current_head.py pass: a fixture complete run owing a review is resumed and its obligations list no review-missing or promotable-stale for the old head; a review queued before the resume is withdrawn and recorded as superseded; after the run delivers a new head, review-missing names the new head; a run that is not resumed keeps its duties, which is the control. The gate log shows them failing on the base commit. Gate, run in place on the fleet allocation, with baseline_suite and after_suite recorded as flat manifest records whose logs name their revision, tree and literal command on the first line and end with their EXIT line: PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/reckon/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_a_duty_follows_the_current_head.py tests/test_crew_obligations.py tests/test_coordinator_obligations_hook.py tests/test_mcp_crew_obligations.py tests/test_obligations_do_not_mislead.py tests/test_obligations_hook_reads_the_snapshot.py tests/test_a_resume_is_drawn_working_again.py tests/test_a_review_waits_for_its_repair.py tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py, judged by failure delta against the base revision; ruff check and ruff format --check clean on the changed paths.
